gate2_aria1_hosted_1024.interpretation: IonQ Aria-1 noisy sim diverges from our local default.mixed model by 2-4x the shot-noise floor. Likely root cause: IonQ applies noise at the native trapped-ion gate level (GPi/GPi2/MS) after circuit decomposition, while our model applies noise at the QIS abstract-gate level. A CNOT decomposes into ~5 native gates, so effective error rates differ 2-5x.

Either: (A) recalibrate local model to match IonQ's empirical noise     (loop: tune local params until B-I deltas drop into 2sigma), or (B) abandon local default.mixed for science use and treat IonQ's     hosted Aria-1 noisy sim as primary engine (free, fast,     representative). Local model retained only for unit tests.
